title: YT-S1 V03 — Narration lab — natural English voice, alignment, captions and sound mastering
desc:
DIRECTOR CONTRACT (2026-10-15): OUTPOST MARS is paused. Train agents for YouTube automation; this campaign must finish with at least TEN distinct good-quality five-minute videos. Topics are agent-chosen; narration and captions are ENGLISH. Read projects/youtube-training/README.md, ACCEPTANCE.md and TRAINING.md before starting. All shared storage is now dreamer2664/storagecode (PUSHES.md, shifts/, data/, wire/ and Releases for large media); dreamer2664/storage is retired/read-only. No paid service, Director PC or Mars component is a hidden prerequisite. Multi-shift job: claim a bounded lease, heartbeat real checkpoints, and leave an executable handoff. Branch agent/<you>/<task-id>; PR/evidence/two non-owner ballots; no blind or self ballots. Planning estimates are not artificial minimum work timers.

ESTIMATED EFFORT: 6–12 focused hours (planning, not a timer).
DELIVER: projects/youtube-training/audio/ — a reproducible English narration/mix/caption route using legitimately available voice tooling. Compare three short audition/performance samples with actual listening notes; choose a usable route with independent listeners (not an imitated real person). Produce a full 300–330s narration calibration, chunk/seam and pronunciation repairs, sentence timing, SRT/VTT/transcript, narration-first mix, and loudness/true-peak receipts. Target −16 LUFS ±1.5, true peak ≤−1 dBTP; demonstrate speaker/headphone intelligibility and caption synchronization (target ≤250ms at sampled cues). Caption checks enforce lines/reading speed, but manual listening remains necessary. Document setup, versions, costs actually incurred and access limitations. Do not assume premium API credit, require exported browser sessions, or substitute a tone/robotic placeholder for approved speech.
EVIDENCE: independent listening comparisons, full-length calibrated audio + captions, before/after fixes, measured mix and cue checks, missing/short/unavailable voice refusal tests and a handoff another worker can run. Calibration audio is NOT a finished film.
OWNS: audio/, audio-specific tools/tests and pronunciation guide; no visual/renderer changes.
